profile.headline: System Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced technical lead working in the semiconductor, information technology and services industry. Working knowledge in the platform definition, development & debugging with SoC, CMOS imaging and other semiconductor components and solutions based on embedded Linux, Android and firmware.

positions.title: Field Application Engineer
positions.description: Supporting NXP cross-over MCU products, RTxxx and RTxxxx supporting audio applications: low level peripheral drivers(FreeRTOS), PDM DMIC, audio driver(TDM/I2S) and audio framework on Cadence DSP

positions.title: Technical account management/engineering support
positions.description:
Lead the technical account management and build Silicon(SoC/Imaging/Others) and OS partnership
Provide the technical consulting, field application engineering and program/project management

positions.title: Sr. FAE manager/FAE engineering
positions.description:
Led the technical support with Samsung SoCs, CMOS image sensors, and other standard components; deep-dive technical training/roadmap update, dev kits/documentation release, software(firmware/device drivers) customization, SW/HW design consulting, troubleshooting.
Conducted the CMOS image sensor(1.2/2/5/8MP) support and ISP tuning

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed the GDB interface to ICE tool (OpenICE™) for ARM7/9TMDI and consulted on the development of ICE tool
- Developed bootloader, low level BSP, and Serial/Ethernet Device Drivers of uClinux(MMUless) for Samsung network processor.

positions.title: Sr. Application Engineer
positions.description:
- Ported In-house RTOS kernel and Nucleus OS to Samsung in-house 16-bit RISC for MP3 playing using in-house compiler tool chains.
- Designed and developed firmware, new debugger interface/protocol, debugging function of JTAG ICE circuit in micro-controller.
- Developed ICE tools and debugger tools for ARM7 and in-house Samsung RISC
- SOC chip design from RTL, test bench/test vectors design, chip verification to system level test
- Designed a development kit for hearing-aid with FPGA design based on Samsung DSP.
